Kashubian

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]
Etymology tree
Proto-Indo-European *-o
Proto-Indo-European *h₂epó
Proto-Indo-European *h₂pó
Proto-Balto-Slavic *pa
Proto-Slavic *po
Kashubian pò

    Inherited from Proto-Slavic *po.

    Pronunciation

    [edit]
    • IPA(key): /ˈpwɛ/
    • Rhymes: -ɛ
    • Syllabification: pò

    Preposition

    [edit]

    pò

    1. after
    2. on
    3. along
    4. round, around
    5. according to
